name: spectral-filter
description:
A brick-wall band-pass with a tilt, drawn straight onto the spectrum.

`binhz` is the frequency of the bin being worked out, so a filter is just
a gain written as a function of frequency.  Nothing here has a phase
response: every bin is scaled, none is turned.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
